summary: Iteration 2 full backend + frontend regression. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests passed (13 new pedigree/email/derivation + 27 iter1 regression). Verified: empty pedigree scaffold, PUT upsert (owner + admin), 403 non-owner, 404 missing patient, hereditary_cancer pedigree-derived matches hc_two_plus_first_degree_breast + hc_ashkenazi_breast_ovarian with family_breast_cancer_first_degree_count=2 and pedigree_used=true, user override (fbfdc=5 wins), family_history first_degree routine escalating to urgent with reproductive_planning, carrier_screening cs_ashkenazi (requires ancestries=['ashkenazi']), hc_male_breast_family via paternal_uncle_aunt M+breast_cancer, GET /email/status returns {configured:false,from:''}, POST /assessments/{id}/email returns 503 with 'GMAIL_ADDRESS' in detail, all 6 standalone pathways unchanged. Frontend Playwright: /patients/:id/pedigree renders pedigree-svg with 7 shapes and 7 fixed-relation rows (paternal_grandfather..proband), add-sibling-btn adds a sibling and ped-affected+ped-cond-<id>-breast_cancer selects; save-pedigree-btn triggers 'Pedigree saved' toast. PatientDetail open-pedigree-btn navigates to /pedigree. AssessmentResult open-email-dialog-btn opens dialog showing 'Email is not configured yet' warning with send-email-btn disabled. NewAssessment patient-select for a patient with non-empty pedigree renders pedigree-hint block 'Pedigree on file'.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y warning only, not user-visible

action_items: (minor) Consider auto-injecting 'ashkenazi' into ancestries list when pedigree.ashkenazi_ancestry=true in pedigree.derive_features, so cs_ashkenazi triggers from the pedigree-level toggle alone. Currently users must also tick the Ashkenazi checkbox under 'Reported ancestries'. Present UI does emit both, so no user-visible break; documented as a defensive alignment.
(a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to EmailReferralDialog DialogContent.
critical_code_review_comments: pedigree.derive_features stores ashkenazi_ancestry bool AND ancestries list separately; decision_engine.evaluate_carrier only reads the ancestries list for cs_ashkenazi/cs_thalassemia. Mismatch is invisible today because the UI writes both fields, but a JSON-only client could set ashkenazi_ancestry=true without adding 'ashkenazi' to ancestries and lose the match.
email_sender.send_referral_email uses synchronous smtplib inside async endpoint — will block event loop while sending. Consider run_in_executor / asyncio.to_thread.

server.upsert_pedigree does not validate proband row exists nor that fixed-relation IDs are unique — malformed payloads with duplicate relations would persist as-is. Low risk since UI enforces via ensureFixed.
PedigreeEditor: two save buttons share the same testid family (save-pedigree-btn + save-pedigree-btn-bottom); acceptable but note both fire the same handler.
seed_data_creation: Provider patient pat_91e93d431568 (TEST_FT_PED) w/ pedigree (ashkenazi_ancestry=true, mother+breast_cancer) + assessment asm_e53bc2c2fb04 for email-dialog UI check. Tests also create TEST_PED_* and TEST_ADM_* patients per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files under /app/backend/tests: backend_test.py (iter1 regression, 27 tests) and test_pedigree_email.py (iter2, 13 tests). Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend auth via localStorage.setItem('session_token', <token>). GMAIL_ADDRESS/GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD are intentionally empty — the 503+not-configured dialog is expected behavior. When testing cs_ashkenazi via pedigree, remember to also set ancestries=['ashkenazi'] (not just the ashkenazi_ancestry bool).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. One minor coverage gap flagged as action item.
